scope: Colorectal carcinoma, WHO Classification of Digestive System Tumours 5th ed. (2019). Histology is comparatively simpler; the action is in the molecular/MMR axis. Internal substrate only.

classification_records.morphology: Gland-forming malignant epithelium; graded low (well/moderately diff, >=50% glands) vs high (poorly diff, <50% glands).
classification_records.grading_system: Two-tier (low- vs high-grade) by gland formation; note MSI-H tumors often look high-grade but behave better
classification_records.clinical_note: Default colorectal carcinoma. Grade by gland formation, but MMR status reframes prognosis independent of morphology.

classification_records.morphology: >50% of the tumor composed of extracellular mucin.
molecular_signature: enriched for MSI-H and CIMP/BRAF in right-sided tumors
classification_records.grading_system: Grade by MMR status: MSI-H mucinous = low-grade; MSS mucinous = high-grade
classification_records.clinical_note: Mucinous morphology correlates with MSI and right-sided location; MMR status drives the grade interpretation.

classification_records.morphology: >50% signet-ring cells with intracytoplasmic mucin displacing the nucleus.
classification_records.clinical_note: Adverse morphology; exclude metastatic gastric/lobular-breast signet-ring mimics by clinical/IHC context.

classification_records.morphology: Well-differentiated NET (organoid) graded 1-3 by Ki-67/mitoses; poorly differentiated NEC; mixed neuroendocrine-non-neuroendocrine neoplasm (MiNEN).
molecular_signature: NEC shares TP53/RB1 with other high-grade NEC
classification_records.grading_system: NET G1/G2/G3 by Ki-67 & mitoses; NEC high-grade; MiNEN by component proportions
classification_records.clinical_note: Distinct from adenocarcinoma; the NET grading axis (Ki-67) parallels other GI/pancreatic NETs.

notes: Colorectal classification is molecular-forward: morphology is simpler, but MMR/MSI status reframes grade and prognosis. Sidedness (right vs left) correlates with molecular pathway. Verify grading specifics at write time.
